"""Synthetic paired full-preflight cost; no real Hermes home or host compression."""
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import types

root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
import tests.conftest  # register hermes_lcm only, with the CI host stub
from hermes_lcm.compaction import CompactionMixin
from hermes_lcm.config import LCMConfig
from hermes_lcm.engine import LCMEngine
from tests.test_active_tool_stubbing import tool_pair

out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
scratch = Path(os.environ["HERMES_HOME"]).parent
base = "10407e12e33c1d7b09fe0e05141153555aec5d62"
source = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(root), "show", base + ":compaction.py"], text=True)
module = types.ModuleType("hermes_lcm.compaction_baseline")
module.__package__ = "hermes_lcm"
sys.modules[module.__name__] = module
exec(compile(source, "baseline-compaction.py", "exec"), module.__dict__)
engine_source = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(root), "show", base + ":engine.py"], text=True)
engine_module = types.ModuleType("hermes_lcm.engine_baseline")
engine_module.__package__ = "hermes_lcm"
sys.modules[engine_module.__name__] = engine_module
exec(compile(engine_source, "baseline-engine.py", "exec"), engine_module.__dict__)
classes = {"baseline": module.CompactionMixin, "candidate": CompactionMixin}
engine_classes = {"baseline": engine_module.LCMEngine, "candidate": LCMEngine}
summary = []
with (out / "pairs.jsonl").open("w") as raw:
    for count in (10_000, 100_000):
        config = LCMConfig(database_path=str(scratch / f"cost-{count}.db"),
            fresh_tail_count=32, leaf_chunk_tokens=20_000,
            large_output_externalization_enabled=True,
            large_output_externalization_threshold_chars=1_000_000,
            large_output_active_replay_stubbing_enabled=True,
            large_output_active_replay_stub_threshold_tokens=5)
        engine = LCMEngine(config=config, hermes_home=str(scratch / f"cost-home-{count}"))
        engine.on_session_start("cost", conversation_id="cost", context_length=200_000)
        engine.threshold_tokens = 100_000
        conn = engine._store._conn
        conn.executemany("INSERT INTO messages (session_id,conversation_id,role,content,timestamp,token_estimate) VALUES ('cost','cost','user',?,1700000000,5)",
            [(f"synthetic historical row {i}",) for i in range(count - 3)])
        conn.commit()
        view = [{"role": "system", "content": "system"}, *tool_pair("live", "synthetic live payload " * 100)]
        engine._ingest_messages(view)
        actual = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE session_id='cost'").fetchone()[0]
        assert actual == count, (actual, count)
        values = {key: [] for key in classes}
        for i in range(210):
            row = {"rows": count, "pair": i - 10, "order": ["baseline", "candidate"] if i % 2 == 0 else ["candidate", "baseline"]}
            for label in row["order"]:
                cls = classes[label]
                engine._should_compress_preflight_impl = cls._should_compress_preflight_impl.__get__(engine)
                engine._replay_diff_requests_ingest_cleanup = cls._replay_diff_requests_ingest_cleanup.__get__(engine)
                for method in ("_ingest_messages", "_build_ingest_replay"):
                    setattr(engine, method, getattr(engine_classes[label], method).__get__(engine))
                started = time.perf_counter_ns()
                result = engine.should_compress_preflight(view)
                elapsed = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
                assert result is (label == "baseline"), (label, result)
                row[label + "_ms"] = elapsed
                if i >= 10:
                    values[label].append(elapsed)
            if i >= 10:
                raw.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")
                raw.flush()
        a, b = [statistics.median(values[key]) for key in ("baseline", "candidate")]
        limit = max(a * .1, .05)
        delta = statistics.median([b - a for a, b in zip(values["baseline"], values["candidate"])])
        result = dict(rows=count, n=200, baseline_median_ms=a, candidate_median_ms=b,
            paired_median_delta_ms=delta, median_delta_ms=b-a, allowed_increase_ms=limit,
            baseline_p10_ms=sorted(values["baseline"])[19], baseline_p90_ms=sorted(values["baseline"])[179],
            candidate_p10_ms=sorted(values["candidate"])[19], candidate_p90_ms=sorted(values["candidate"])[179],
            passed=b-a <= limit and delta <= limit)
        summary.append(result)
        engine.shutdown()
        print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
(out / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(base=base, rows=summary), indent=2) + "\n")
assert all(row["passed"] for row in summary)
